theme_cv_type.desc: Switch camera UI theme from standard (0x11) to Leica CV theme (0x10)

support_cv_type.desc: Enable Leica Authentic/Vibrant photographic styles & 4 Leica shutter sounds

high_dynamic_color_filter.desc: High dynamic color representation from filters

support_legendary_mode.desc: Leica Essential / Legenda Mode (Leica M3 Monopan 50, M9, M10-R)

legend_guide_and_capture_prefs.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to w5()Z (MasterLiveModule / Live cinematography) which requires flagship MasterLiveMiviHsrArray HAL support absent on onyx; Leica Essential stays enabled via support_legendary_mode (i5)

smooth_zoom_3sat.desc: Smooth SAT zooming optimization (runtime-controlled by OnyxPortHelper.isSmoothZoomEnabled)

smooth_zoom_bar_v2_a.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to B2()Z (Cinemaster / Pro Video HDR10+ flag, not needed by Smooth Zoom Mod)

smooth_zoom_bar_v2_b.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to S8()Z (isVideoHdr10OrPlusModeSupported flagship flag; stock onyx already enables Q8()Z for native HDR10)

zoom_manager_flagship.desc: Flagship zoom manager optimization in Photo/Night

equip_street_support_a.desc: DISABLED on onyx: onyx HAL reports supportedfeatures.streetFeatureMask=0 (Fastshot/EquipStreet unsupported)

equip_street_support_b.desc: DISABLED on onyx: onyx HAL reports supportedfeatures.streetFeatureMask=0 (Fastshot/EquipStreet unsupported)

street_launch_support.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to N3()Z (StreetModule / Fastshot) which onyx HAL does not support (streetFeatureMask=0)

pro_video_custom_lut.desc: Pro Video custom LUT import (.cube) & Film LUTs (Warm/Cool/Classic/709)

video_watermark_and_hdr.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to l7()Z (Dolby Vision top-bar + AiAudioTrack), dead on onyx HAL (no DOLBY_CONFIG / no AiAudioTrack)

true_colour_video.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to i3()Z (Dolby Vision Video), dead button on onyx HAL (DolbyHDREISSupported=0, VideoHDRSupportFeature=16)

cinematic_mode.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to D2()Z (Movie / CinematicModule opmode 0x8032), onyx HAL reports supportedfeatures.cinematic=0

custom_tint_color.desc: Custom UI Accent / Tint Color selector

ultrapixel_capture_duration.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to B5()Z (isSupport200M) which breaks 50MP IMX882 mode

super_jpeg_quality.desc: DISABLED on onyx: forces JPEG Quality=100 (all-1s DQT) which overflows onyx 50MP MIVI JPEG buffer (4.48MB truncation)

capture_method_prefs.desc: DISABLED on onyx: resolves to C5()Z (module_name_pixel_xxxm 200MP label)
